key.name: app-blacklist
key.description: List of app names, IDs, or WM classes to hide from the menu bar.

key.name: menu-icon
key.description: Icon for the system menu (position 0). Leave empty to auto-detect from your distro. Select "Apple" to use the Apple logo.

key.name: lock-to-focused-app
key.description: When enabled, the app menu stays locked to the currently focused app even when hovering over the panel.

key.name: show-os-icon
key.description: Show the system menu (logo) button in the top panel with quick-launch utilities.

key.name: show-user-switcher
key.description: Show the user switcher button in the top panel for fast user switching.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Write AppMenu diagnostic logs to the GNOME Shell journal. Keep disabled for normal use.

key.name: show-workspace-indicator
key.description: Show workspace navigation dots in the top panel.

key.name: workspace-indicator-position
key.description: Panel side for the workspace indicator. Supported values: left, right.

key.name: search-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut used to open AppMenu Search.

key.name: use-real-menus
key.description: When available, import real exported application menus over D-Bus.

key.name: prefer-macos-style
key.description: Retained for dconf compatibility. No longer used by AppMenu.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Panel icon size in pixels (12–36).

key.name: show-terminal
key.description: Show a Terminal launcher in the system menu.

key.name: terminal-command
key.description: Custom terminal command. Leave empty for automatic detection (ptyxis, gnome-terminal, etc.).

key.name: show-software-center
key.summary: Show Software Center in System Menu
key.description: Show a Software Center launcher in the system menu.

key.name: software-center-command
key.description: Custom software center command. Leave empty for automatic detection.

key.name: show-system-monitor
key.summary: Show System Monitor in System Menu
key.description: Show a System Monitor launcher in the system menu.

key.name: system-monitor-command
key.description: Custom system monitor command. Leave empty for automatic detection.

key.name: show-extensions-app
key.description: Show an Extensions launcher in the system menu.

key.name: extensions-app-id
key.description: Desktop ID for the extensions application.

key.name: show-app-grid
key.summary: Show App Grid in System Menu
key.description: Show an App Grid entry in the system menu.

key.name: show-force-quit
key.summary: Show Force Quit in System Menu
key.description: Show a Force Quit entry in the system menu.

key.name: show-power-options
key.description: Show Sleep, Restart, and Shut Down in the system menu.

key.name: show-lock-screen
key.description: Show Lock Screen in the system menu.

key.name: show-log-out
key.description: Show Log Out in the system menu.

key.name: hide-overview-button
key.description: Hide the GNOME Shell Activities/Overview button from the top panel.

key.name: distro-icon-name
key.description: Distro name for bundled icon selection (e.g. fedora, ubuntu, debian).

key.name: distro-icon-symbolic
key.description: Prefer the symbolic (monochrome) variant of the distro icon.

key.name: custom-icon-path
key.description: Absolute path to a custom system menu icon image.

key.name: system-menu-custom-items
key.description: JSON array of {label, value} objects for custom system-menu launchers.

key.name: custom-app-menus
key.description: JSON array of {label, enabled, items: [{label, kind: "command"|"shortcut", value}]} for custom top-level menus.
